title: Fiona
summary: An older woman found recording the abandoned world on a dead phone, connected to the route toward the Other Camp.
intro: Fiona is met after the hospital return, when the player follows new route evidence toward the Other Camp. She appears friendly, grandmotherly, and impossible: her phone has no service, no charge, and still records things that later appear in Omni's broadcasts.
facts: Fiona is found in the old neighborhood beyond the main town route.
She carries a phone that behaves impossibly in the no-service zone.
She knows details about the Other Camp before the player reaches it.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Fiona is introduced as a warm and talkative figure in a part of the town that is empty. She records the player on her phone and acts as if documentation is more important than escape.

Her friendliness makes her unsettling because she speaks like someone giving a tour of a memory. She knows where the sidewalks crack, which houses still have names on the doors, and which route leads to the Other Camp.
Fiona does not treat the empty world as a disaster. She treats it as something that needs to be remembered correctly.
items: First meeting: old neighborhood route after the hospital return.
Primary function: guides the player toward the Other Camp.
Behavior notes: warm, precise, archival, too comfortable with impossible silence.
Reveal thread: Fiona's recordings appear in Omni broadcasts before she uploads or sends them.

sections.heading: Story Role
paragraphs: Fiona gives the late-midgame story a different kind of unease. Frank is loud and Greg is procedural, but Fiona is intimate. She acts like she already knows the player belongs in the story she is preserving.
Her phone becomes a clue object. It displays images from places the player has not reached and records voices that do not speak nearby.
At the Other Camp, Fiona's name appears on old resident lists with conflicting dates. She is both witness and evidence.
items: Connection to the Player: treats the player like a missing entry finally returned.
Connection to The Camp: recognizes its rules but calls them the newer version.
Connection to Omni: records memories before they happen.
